news.text: "A Battle-Ready #Juve"In Vigo against #CeltaVigo (9 PM): #Spalletti shakes things up."I want them to be ferocious and venomous. I ask the players to respect the history of our club". An opportunity for #Woltemade.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

WOLTE BREAKTHROUGH?At 9 PM: #CeltaVigo-#JuveThe German has an opportunity in Vigo that he cannot afford to waste: for #Spalletti today and for his own future.Disappointing so far, #Woltemade must convince the coach, the fans and the club which for January is already looking for a new forward to partner with #Kolo. Lucio: "I am counting on him and I have already activated battle mode. I demand ferocity. This is a Champions League 2: we want to go all the way". #Conceição launches himself: "Me like #Salah? I can do better..." [Front Page TuttoSport]
